data.name: Noshad
data.gender_notes: Noshad is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Noshad is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of two words, 'Nos' meaning 'God' and 'Shad' meaning 'Grace'. This name signifies the divine grace bestowed upon an individual by the gods. It is a name that evokes feelings of strength, courage, and power. The name Noshad carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Noshad usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Noshad is a spiritual name that represents the connection between an individual and the divine. It is a name that signifies the presence of God's grace in one's life and the strength and courage that comes from that connection.
data.etymology: Noshad belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noshad total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Noshad was a Jain monk and a disciple of Mahavira. He is believed to have lived during the 6th century BCE and was one of the early leaders of Jainism in Magadha, present day Bihar, India.
historical_references.context: Jain monk and early leader of Jainism in Magadha

historical_references.reference: Noshad is also mentioned in the 12th century CE Jain text 'Prabandha Ratnavali' by Hemachandra. Here, Noshad is described as a prominent Jain monk and an accomplished scholar who was renowned for his deep knowledge and teachings of Jainism.
historical_references.context: Prominent Jain monk and accomplished scholar
